name: Robert Brown

learned: Robert Brown is a poet. Tom Brown's father. Member of Literary Club with Tom Brown and Jennifer Moore. Trust in government: moderately high—he generally believes government institutions and public agencies are competent and well-intentioned enough to manage environmental risks through regulation, expert advice, and gradual policy updates, and he prefers coordinated solutions delivered through established processes.
